newsitem.title: USA: Archer Daniels Midland names Andreas nephew CEO.
newsitem.headline: Archer Daniels Midland names Andreas nephew CEO.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co., the agribusiness giant, said Thursday its board of directors named G. Allen Andreas chief executive officer, succeeding Dwayne Andreas, his uncle, in the post.
The company said Dwayne Andreas will remain chairman of the board of directors.
Lowell Andreas, a past president of the company and Dwayne Andreas' brother, is retiring from the board. The 1996 proxy listed Lowell Andreas' age as 74.
The company said Andrew Young, former ambassador to the United Nations, was elected to the board for the balance of the current term.

ADM said the changes followed a letter written two months ago by Dwayne Andreas to O. Glenn Webb, chairman of the firm's Salary, Succession and Stock Option Committee, asking for the committee to begin a plan of succession by dividing the offices of chairman and chief executive officer.

In October 1996, ADM formed a four-member office of the chief executive, which had included Allen Andreas. Other executives in that office included Dwayne Andreas, President James Randall, and Charles Bayless, president of the processing division.
ADM's stock was off 12.5 cents at $17.50 on the New York Stock Exchange.
